questions.questionText:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III.
Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with
commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.

All birds are parrots.
No parrot is a crow.
Some owls are crows.
Conclusions:
I. Some parrots are owls.
II. No crow is a bird.
III. No owl is a bird.
options: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (C).
